About Craven & Quill

Coloring books made the slow way

We're a small independent press with one idea: original coloring books, drawn with care and built to be enjoyed without a deadline.

Why Craven & Quill

Craven & Quill started with a simple question: what would a coloring book look like if it took its own name seriously? Not a pile of unrelated pages, but a proper little world — a recurring cast, a consistent place, scenes that add up to something instead of forty disconnected drawings.

Every book we make is built the same way: pick a world worth spending forty pages in, draw it with clean, closed lines that are satisfying to fill in, and leave enough open space that the page is still yours to finish, not ours.

We keep the promises modest on purpose. We won't tell you a page will melt your stress away in ten minutes, and we won't claim paper that can survive every marker on the market. What we will do is tell you plainly what's inside, show you real sample pages, and let the coloring speak for itself.

What We Believe

How we make a Craven & Quill book

Original, every time

New characters and scenes for every book — nothing traced or templated from someone else's world.

No rush, no rules

No timers, no "correct" way to finish a page. Color it in one sitting or come back to it in a year.

Honest about materials

We tell you plainly what the paper can and can't handle, rather than promising more than a printed book can deliver.

Printed only when ordered

Every copy is printed on demand by Amazon when someone orders it — no warehouse of unsold stock.

Meet the books

Three original collections, all $9.99, all the same cozy square format.
